question: What power to shake the triple world arises from always contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored form is to be contemplated always.
The triple world is the object affected.
The practitioner may cause it to shake.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
